title: crassula alpina
intro: Crassula alpina, commonly known as the Mountain Crassula, is a succulent plant species native to the high-altitude regions of the Cape Mountains in South Africa. This plant is known for its unique, small leaves and stems that are able to store water, making it drought-resistant. The health benefits of Crassula alpina include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, thanks to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Crassula alpina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
